title: Self Monitoring
description: Is the monitoring itself working? Every alert in the 'meta', 'logs-pipeline' and 'traces' rule groups has a chart here.

panels.title: Exporters
panels.description: Every exporter scrape target. DOWN here = TargetDown alert after 1m.

panels.title: Watchdog
panels.description: Always-firing alert. SILENT = Prometheus rule evaluation or alert delivery is broken.

panels.title: Telegram failures (1h)
panels.description: Above 0 = alerts are not reaching you. Usual cause: wrong TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / chat id in .env.

panels.title: Notifications sent / failed
panels.description: Per minute. Any 'failed' line above 0 fires AlertmanagerNotificationsFailing.

panels.title: Remote write lag to VictoriaMetrics
panels.description: Seconds between newest scraped and newest sent sample. Red line = PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind.

panels.title: New series/min
panels.description: High churn (many new series) = a label with unbounded values somewhere.

panels.title: VictoriaLogs data size
panels.description: Red line = -retention.maxDiskSpaceUsageBytes (20GiB): oldest days deleted above it.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)
